Digital Marketing Executive Job at Dame Chops & Events




        
    

        
        Dame Chops & Events is a professional catering and event management company dedicated to creating memorable experiences through quality food, excellent service, and well-coordinated events. We specialize in indoor and outdoor catering, event planning, food trays, small chops, corporate events, birthdays, weddings, and special celebrations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Digital Marketing Executive 

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Build our digital marketing roadmap
	Manage all digital marketing channels (e.g. website, blogs, emails and social media) to ensure brand consistency
	Measure ROI and KPIs and prepare budget
	Develop specific campaigns to create and maintain high levels of customer interaction
	Oversee our social media accounts
	Manage and improve online content, considering SEO and Google Analytics
	Forecast sales performance trends and act proactively to increase our market segment
	Liaise with Product, Design and Sales directors to increase client satisfaction through cohesive strategies
	Motivate digital marketing team to achieve goals
	Monitor competition and provide ideas to stand out
	Stay up-to-date with digital technology developments


Requirements and skills


	HND Degree in Marketing, Digital technology.
	Proven work experience as a Digital marketing director
	Demonstrable experience in designing and implementing successful digital marketing campaigns
	Strong understanding of how all current digital marketing channels function
	Solid knowledge of online marketing tools and best practices
	Hands on experience with SEO/SEM, Google Analytics and CRM software
	Familiarity with web design
	Excellent analytical and project management skills
	Strong team management and communication (written and verbal) skills.


Salary
N180,000 - N200,000 per month. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

title: Job Openings at Capitol Hill Hospitals
content:
Capitol Hill Hospitals is a healthcare organization committed to providing high-quality, compassionate, and patient-centred healthcare services. We are dedicated to promoting excellence in healthcare delivery through the use of modern medical practices, skilled professionals, and a strong culture of safety, integrity, and continuous improvement.

At Capitol Hill Hospitals, we believe that exceptional healthcare begins with exceptional people. Our team comprises dedicated medical, nursing, administrative, and support professionals who work collaboratively to provide safe, efficient, and personalized care to every patient.
     

            
    



We are committed to creating a professional and supportive work environment where employees can develop their skills, contribute meaningfully, and build rewarding careers. Through continuous learning, teamwork, innovation, and adherence to professional standards, we strive to raise the standard of healthcare delivery. Our vision is to be the Vanguard and the preferred choice in cutting-edge patient care service. At Capitol Hill Hospitals, we care for people, develop people, and empower people to make a difference in healthcare.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Chief Operations Officer

Job Location: Warri, Delta

Responsibilities


	Provide strategic and operational leadership across the organisation.
	Oversee day-to-day operations and ensure efficient delivery of healthcare and support services.
	Develop and implement operational strategies, policies, and performance standards.
	Drive organisational growth, efficiency, profitability, and service excellence.
	Establish and monitor departmental KPIs and ensure accountability for results.
	Lead and coordinate departmental heads towards the achievement of organisational objectives.
	Identify operational risks and implement effective solutions.
	Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, quality standards, and organisational policies.
	Analyse operational and business data to support informed management decisions.
	Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.
	Work closely with the Managing Director and leadership team to execute the organisation's strategic vision.


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor's / Master's Degree with 7 - 10 years of work experience.


Application Closing Date: 20th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV / Applications to: [email protected] using "Chief Operating Officer (COO)" as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Specialist Obstetrician & Gynaecologist Consultant

Job Location: Warri, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Requirements


	MBBS or equivalent medical qualification.
	Minimum of 5 years of post-specialisation experience.
	FMCOG, FWACS, or equivalent recognised specialist qualification.
	Valid registration and practising licence with the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN).
	Strong clinical, diagnostic, surgical, and decision-making skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong commitment to patient-centred care and clinical excellence.


Application Closing Date: 18th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV/Applications to: [email protected] using ''Consultant Gynaecologist'' as the subject of the email.

 

 

3.) Human Resources / Admin Manager

Job Location: Warri, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

What You'll Do


	Drive HR strategy, policy, and full employee lifecycle management
	Lead recruitment, performance management, and staff development
	Oversee payroll, benefits, and statutory/regulatory compliance (PENCOM, ITF, NDPR)
	Champion employee engagement and workplace culture.
	Advise leadership with data-driven HR insights.


What You Bring


	Bachelor's Degree in HR, Business Admin, or related fields
	5–6 years of HR experience (healthcare sector preferred)
	Professional HR certification (ACIPM required)
	Strong grasp of labour law, payroll, and HRIS tools.
	Great communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.


Application Closing Date: 12th September, 2026. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

     

    

        Click here to Apply

Marketing Associate Job at Alaro City Development FZC




        
    

        
        Alaro City Development FZC is an integrated, mixed-use city planned for over 2,000 hectares in the North West Quadrant of the Lekki Free Zone. Alaro City’s vision goes beyond alleviating what is a self-evident problem - that of stifling urban congestion and a dearth of quality housing and commercial property in Lagos and Africa as a whole.
     

            
    



Rather, we aim to help create the infrastructure - the living and working spaces, communities, schools, and hospitals - that will help sustain and accelerate Nigeria’s economic growth, meet the aspirations of Africa’s burgeoning middle classes, and serve as a catalyst for further urban development. The people in our team are multi-skilled and experts in their respective fields. They possess a unique drive, underpinned by the desire to help improve Africa’s urban development.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Marketing Associate 

Job Location: Lagos
Reporting Line: Marketing Manager
Start Date: Immediately

Responsibilities


	Support in the execution of the annual marketing plan
	Plan and execute all web, SEO/SEM, marketing database, email, social media and display advertising campaigns
	Storytelling to capture the Alaro City opportunity as well as development progress
	Provide analysis of existing PR environment and brand perception with target audiences, identify key risks to the brand from the PR and marketing perspective
	Develop a social media plan each week and ensure at least 5 posts a week on each social media channel - 5 on Twitter, 5 on Facebook and 5 on Instagram
	Measure the effectiveness of implemented advertising, marketing and communications strategies to improve customer awareness of the Nigerian projects
	Update LinkedIn with news, events, and images
	Update the YouTube account with project videos
	Update website with news, events, and images and other relevant content
	Design, build and maintain our social media presence
	Measure and report performance of all digital marketing campaigns, and assess against goals (ROI and KPIs)
	Plan, execute, and measure experiments and conversion tests
	Identify digital trends and insights, and optimize spend and performance based on the insights
	Contribute to the production and distribution of the monthly newsletters
	Update database of marketing/stakeholder contacts on Mailchimp every month
	Generate online marketing leads to support the overall marketing target
	Devise strategies to drive online traffic to the company website
	Utilize a range of techniques including paid search, SEO and PPC to support the marketing strategy
	Improve the usability, design, content and conversion of the company website
	Assist in the procurement of suppliers for marketing activities.
	Evaluate customer research, market conditions and competitor data
	Review new technologies and keep the company at the forefront of developments in digital marketing
	All other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Marketing Manager
	Work collaboratively with the sales team and use customer centric insight to influence the marketing strategy and encourage advantageous outcomes for Alaro City
	Provide marketing activity impact assessments that will feed into the weekly marketing reporting
	Write articles, press releases, etc. for print and online media


Requirements
Hard skills and experience:


	Bachelor's Degree in a Marketing related discipline from a reputable university or tertiary institution;
	6 - 8 years of experience in digital marketing preferably in Real Estate;
	Very strong digital marketing, research and analytical skills;
	Excellent written and oral communication skills.


Soft skills:


	Mature, pragmatic and flexible approach, strong commercial judgment
	Team player but comfortable working autonomously
	Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
	Good negotiation skills
	Good attention to detail
	Rigorous and organised approach
	Hands-on, ready to roll up the sleeves.


Personal characteristics: 


	High energy
	Result-oriented
	Strong work ethic
	Ability to work effectively under pressure.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR Specialist

	Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of HR data.

	Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Social Sciences, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
	7 - 10 years of experience in HR Operations, HRIS Management, HR Analytics and Reporting, or a similar role.
	CIPM, CIPD, SHRM, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP HCM, HR Analytics, or Data Analytics certifications are desirable.
	Hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors and exposure to SAP HCM.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and HR reporting tools.
	Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills.
	Experience in a large corporate, manufacturing, or multi-location environment will be an added advantage.

	Analytical Thinking
	Attention to Detail

	Confidentiality & Professional Ethics.
